blockers.finding: The pre-download guard uses ^[0-9a-f]{64}$. The .NET $ anchor may match before a final LF, so 64 lowercase hex characters plus LF pass this guard and reach Invoke-WebRequest on a miss. The later full digest comparison fails, so this does not permit extraction of a mismatching archive; it violates malformed-pin refusal before download.
blockers.missing_regression: Existing malformed-pin parameters cover empty,63 hex,64 uppercase,and nonhex; no terminal LF.
blockers.recommended_fix: Use absolute anchors \A[0-9a-f]{64}\z and add an inert terminal-LF regression asserting no download/extraction/export.
blockers.evidence_scope: Source and standard .NET regex semantics; no PowerShell/native execution.

confirmed_findings: All current URL/digest bytes are moved unchanged from the parent and match the retained Tier R convention.
The cache input is only ghidra-archive with the full digest key; no restore-keys, extracted-tree cache or hit-based skip is added.
The install step downloads only if the fixed original ZIP is absent. A present corrupt ZIP is retained, fails its digest check, preserves prior extraction and exports no runtime.
The digest comparison precedes runtime removal; successful verification is logged before a fresh extraction; download/hash/removal/extraction errors are terminating.

Nine tiny authored PowerShell fixtures cover 4 cold/restored valid/corrupt combinations,4 malformed pins,and matching-digest/nonZIP extraction failure. Only the downloader is replaced, and ZIP contents contain one text file with no executable payload.
Windows explicitly fails the fixture setup when pwsh is missing; other platforms skip visibly. No skipped fixture was executed in this review.

Retained pinned action metadata has success-only post-save; README scopes cache to key/version/branch and documents default cross-OS false. A matching literal key alone proves neither restore nor save.

Cold/warm qualification remains separate: successful cold download/verify/extract/save first, then actual same-scope restore/verify/extract, retaining all five native outcomes. Raw-result cache is separate.
upstream_provenance_limit: Retained official pinned-URL receipts and their exact content hashes were checked against the sealed author archive. No new upstream GET or Git object fetch was performed.
